_metadata.title: BIS Standards Trigger Map — FireRuleX
_metadata.description: Maps NBC Part 4 fire-fighting installations to the primary BIS technical standards that become active when the system is required.

IS 2190.title: Selection, Installation & Maintenance of First-aid Fire Extinguishers
IS 2190.scope: Fire extinguisher classes A/B/C/D/F, quantities, mounting, and inspection.

IS 884.title: First-aid Hose Reel for Fire Fighting
IS 884.scope: Design and performance of first-aid hose reel drums.

IS 3844.title: Installation & Maintenance of Internal Fire Hydrants and Hose Reel Systems
IS 3844.scope: Wet risers, down comers, internal hydrants, hose reels — pressure, spacing, testing.

IS 13039.title: External Hydrant Systems — Provision and Maintenance
IS 13039.scope: Yard hydrant ring main, hydrant locations, terminal pressures.

IS 5290.title: Landing Valves for Fire Fighting Systems
IS 5290.scope: Landing valves for wet risers / yard hydrants.

IS 9668.title: Provision of Water Supplies for Fire Fighting
IS 9668.scope: Static water tanks, underground/terrace storage capacities.

IS 15301.title: Installation and Maintenance of Fire Pumps
IS 15301.scope: Electric + diesel fire pumps, jockey pump, capacities.

IS 15105.title: Automatic Sprinkler Systems — Code of Practice
IS 15105.scope: Sprinkler hydraulic design, hazard classification, pipe sizing.

IS 2189.title: Selection, Installation & Maintenance of Automatic Fire Detection and Alarm System
IS 2189.scope: Smoke/heat detectors, MCPs, cabling, panel design.

IS 15908.title: Control & Indicating Equipment for Fire Detection and Alarm Systems
IS 15908.scope: Fire alarm control panel functional requirements.
